svg.title: Figure 11.9 Rejection regions: (a) right-tailed; (b) left-tailed; (c) two-tailed
svg.desc: Three F density curves. (a) For Hₐ: σ₁² > σ₂², the right tail of area α above F_α is shaded, and the rejection region is F ≥ F_α. (b) For Hₐ: σ₁² < σ₂², the left tail of area α below F₁₋α is shaded, and the rejection region runs from 0 to F₁₋α. (c) For Hₐ: σ₁² ≠ σ₂², both tails, each of area α/2, are shaded, below F₁₋α/2 and above F_α/2, and the rejection region is both intervals.
